verdict.rationale: Mollie documents fast ways to start taking payments: installing an e-commerce plugin is "enough to start receiving payments", and it also offers hosted checkout pages, no-code payment links and card-field components. Nothing in the pack covers how long signup, account verification or activation takes, so the 'within a day of signing up' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented onboarding or verification timelines showing card payments can go live within a day, and independent or hands-on reports of time-to-first-payment.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: Simply installing the Mollie module from the platform's module store is enough to start receiving payments.
These hosted payment pages allow your customer to select their payment method of choice and to complete the payment.
Mollie JS is a set of Javascript APIs that allow you to add the fields needed for credit card holder data to your own checkout
With the Payment Links API you can generate a payment link to share with your customer.
